title: Claude Code Rules Files: Use .claude/rules for Bigger #claudecode #claude
description:
When CLAUDE.md gets too big, move specific guidance into .claude/rules/. Use one topic per Markdown file, scope rules with paths frontmatter, and check what loaded with /memory. This keeps project memory cleaner and gives Claude the right context only when it matters.
.
.
